title: U.S. Intelligence Warns of China Theft Over Sale of F-35 Jets to Saudis
summary: Internal reports, including one from the Pentagon’s Defense Intelligence Agency, say China could acquire U.S. jet technology through spying or cooperation with Saudi Arabia.
